notes.title: Lila's Sky Ark is out now!
notes.content:
The developers of [b]Resolutiion[/b] have released their second game and we'd like to share that with all of you. [b]Lila's Sky Ark[/b] is now available here on Steam and seeing what Monolith of Minds have created with the folks at Graffiti Games is just amazing. There is also a launch discount during the first week so go and grab the game while it's hot:  [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1573390/Lilas_Sky_Ark/]Lila's Sky Ark on Steam[/url]

[previewyoutube=0T5QEnMAk_Q;full][/previewyoutube]

- Deck13

notes.title: Quality of Life & Death Update Out Now
notes.content:
Twelve month ago we released Resolutiion, our first video game. And boy, have these few months been a ride. Two major updates later (“The Red Plains” and “The Craftsman”) and we realized, that the journey of Valor and Alibii is not the end but a beginning. We wanted to tell a much grander story about humanity and technology; about death and rebirth.

Since late 2020 we are working hard on Resolutiion’s prequel (“Lila’s Sky Ark”), while also planning for the sequel. Both are coming along great, especially for a team of two.

Still, to honour Resolutiion’s birthday, we took some time off our mad schedule, and collected a lot of feedback and bug fixes into the “Quality of Life & Death” Update:

- Various visual improvements
- Remarkably reduced loading times
- Earlier access to  fast travel system (Theremin in Sunken City)
- Tinted map for clearer orientation
- Progression changes, so that parts of the world can be accesses simpler
- Issue 879: a new secret
- Bug fixes & general polish

Happy birthday, Valor.
Happy birthday, Alibii.
Happy birthday, to everybody who was born today.
A great gift to yourself might be to replay your favorite pixel-adventure again.

notes.title: Announcing the “Quality of Life & Death” Update
notes.content:
Resolutiion's next update is scheduled for its very own birthday later this month. 

Our first game will be exactly one year old on May 28, and we will celebrate with the “Quality of Life & Death” Update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35669489/bb4bebb0bcb90eb7bfaf4849ec1213c0247e72e0.png[/img]

If you haven’t explored the world of the Infinite Empire, yet, this is your chance. If you have, why not take another leap into the rabbit hole?

notes.title: Lila’s Sky Ark
notes.content:
[h1]The Rainbow Ark is under attack.[/h1]

Lila and her friends Mr. Kiepchen and Doctor-Father-Sir wake up to find themselves facing a grim foe: The Conductor and his generals who have invaded the sky island, to take all that is magical and musical.

[previewyoutube=grcuPl9jjn0;full][/previewyoutube]

We just announced our next game: [b]Lila’s Sky Ark[/b].

This is the prequel story to Resolutiion: the first Cradle, the original Dreamer, and the birth of the Red Code Universe.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1573390/Lilas_Sky_Ark/]Wishlist Lila’s Sky Ark on Steam[/url]

The game is under heavy development, but we want to make the process as transparent and fun for everybody to follow along. [url=https://discord.gg/uAkZgBp7gz]Come join our Discord server[/url].

We count on you all to share your thoughts and feelings and make this journey as enjoyable as the final game itself.

Early access in Summer 2021; full release in early 2022.

notes.title: The Craftsman Update is here
notes.content:
“I craft the finest emotions. Pain, anger, and the occasional sorrow. Welcome to The Workshop!”

Hidden in the Divided Sea is an abomination. Something so repulsive, you can’t keep away. In Resolutiion’s second content update, say hello to Rolav, the violence aficionado. This dark entity crafts custom weapon modifications for the sophisticated executioner, such as yourself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35669489/47799b00bdbe0052a81ecbbd70a15d021a2775f9.png[/img]

Turn your shotgun into a powerful grenade launcher, or impale a line of enemies with the Delimiter’s energy spike! New weapon variations change Resolutiion’s combat dramatically and open up fresh and creative paths to unleashing destruction.

Make no mistake, though, Rolav’s services come at a price. And that price is facing your darkest shadow.

[list]
[*]The Workshop, a new area in the Divided Sea
[*]The Craftsman, a new optional mini-boss-fight
[*]Weapon variations for the Calmer (Sampler), Resolver (Delimiter), and Haven (Alliance)
[*]The legendary Elevator Party
[*]More guidance for the lost
[*]Various bug fixes and polish
[/list]

notes.title: The Red Plains are here!
notes.content:
“[i]Construction of the Red Code Mirror is in progress …
You must not compromise the memory buffers.[/i]”
—Host

Ascend into the Red Plains, where memories drift through fractured skies. The final journey of Valor and Alibii is nigh, and it will not end well for either. Don’t mind the dead astronauts along the way — they’re from the future.
Resolutiion’s first update features a new combat-heavy biome, expanding the lead-up to the finale. New enemies, friends, and a mysterious host will guide you through the Queen’s Gauntlet right into the Singularity.

[list]
[*]A fresh expansion of the finale
[*]New enemies: v4l0r, VLR, //|_=|>, and the Sequels will challenge even the most seasoned killers
[*]Boss improvements: various mini-bosses receive new attacks and abilities
[*]Spanish translation
[*]Polychromatic: the artbook with less black pages and more spoilers
[*]New otherworldly metal-tracks
[*]Plenty of bug fixes and improvements
[*]The secret Cow Level (Yes!)
[/list]

The Update is live now and part of the Tiny Teams Festival. And in case you are still wondering, if you should get Resolutiion, we have added another argument on the list: During the Festival Resolutiion will be 20% off.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35669489/15e302f1f04f6eba85915c8af840e07e08c66b21.png[/img]

notes.title: Resolutiion Update v1.06 - Aftermath
notes.content:
We call our first Update for Resolutiion Aftermath. Aftermath cause launching a videogame is an amazing experience. But one which also wrecks your nerves and completely blasts your mind. We survived the aftermath and kept working on the game. We went through the bug reports and feature requests.

The best thing? Resolutiion now supports a proper mouse support as well. Even with some bonus-gimmick. We partnered up with SteelSeries and implemented their SDK to give you some cool visual effects:

[previewyoutube=2cV_4uyCYT8;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Patch Notes[/b]
[list]
[*]added proper mouse/keyboard controls
[*]mouse aiming
[*]map mouse buttons to actions
[*]scroll text with mouse wheel
[*] Steel Series bling-bling
[*]Twitch integration: removed 4l1b11 greeting chat members
[*]frame rate cap at 60 fps
[*]fixed crash in "Hallow Valdez"
[*]lots of minor bug fixes[/list]
